translations.web: But don’t you be called ‘Rabbi,’ for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.
translations.bsb: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
translations.kjv: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
translations.asv: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your teacher, and all ye are brethren.
